title: Cleaner controls and better diagnostics
summary: Keep the current Virtual Input workflow in reach while making startup failures and diagnostic logs much easier to find.
highlights: Move the global Disable remapping control into the custom title bar so it remains available without crowding every page header.
Keep Legacy JSON switching and file tools accessible under advanced compatibility controls while focusing the main interface on live Virtual Input mappings.
Store readable Pivot-named logs under Documents/Pivot/Logs and migrate recognized LMUKit-era logs and diagnostic reports automatically.
Capture fatal Rust startup panics before settings load so otherwise silent launch failures leave a useful dated log.
